title: A proton gradient is used
hook: Locate this step in the cell-energy map.

knows: Eukaryotic organelles contain different internal compartments.
doesNotKnow: Protons flow down their electrochemical gradient through ATP synthase toward the mitochondrial matrix, helping drive ATP formation.

misconception: Every step of a pathway occurs in the same compartment.
objective: Locate the stated process in a simplified organelle diagram.

claims.text: Question, diagram and reveal: During mitochondrial ATP synthesis, protons flow through ATP synthase from the intermembrane space toward which compartment? Protons flow down their electrochemical gradient through ATP synthase toward the mitochondrial matrix, helping drive ATP formation.
Organelle shapes and membrane folds are schematic and not to scale.
Recall: In mitochondria, which compartment is enclosed by the inner membrane? The mitochondrial matrix is the space enclosed by the inner membrane.

recall.question: In mitochondria, which compartment is enclosed by the inner membrane?
recall.why: The mitochondrial matrix is the space enclosed by the inner membrane.
